findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "list_cohort_moves" is 1517 chars, far longer than this server's median (267). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: List bulk AP migrations Detected bulk migrations between Access Points, largest first. A cohort is a gap-≤3-day island of (from_provider, to_provider) mover day…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "list_cohort_moves" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.peppolstatus.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_incidents, get_participant_joiners, get_software_stats, get_doctype_stats, get_doctype_family, get_doctype_family_countries, get_doctype_family_providers, get_compliance_stats, get_compliance_stats_history, get_country_providers, list_cohort_move_participants, list_anomalies, list_software_anomalies · Private data: list_public_providers, get_public_provider, get_access_point, get_doctype_stats, get_doctype_stats_history, get_doctype_family, get_doctype_family_countries, get_doctype_family_providers, get_compliance_stats, list_cohort_moves · Public sink: get_summary, list_providers, get_participant_stats, get_software_stats, get_doctype_stats, get_doctype_family, get_doctype_family_countries, get_doctype_family_providers, get_compliance_stats, get_country_providers · Destructive: get_adoption, list_cohort_move_participants.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
